claim_boundary: Execution, numerical concordance with native CLI/R, fault injection handling, and provenance replay. Not claimed as full transcriptome biological discovery.

tolerances.effective_counts_note: Post-hoc technical bound adopted after observing the run, not a pre-registered tolerance: Python vs R Bioconductor tximport lengthScaledTPM counts differ by at most 0.301 in absolute value, and 36/500 entries exceed the pre-registered 1e-5 rtol / 1e-4 atol, so the count matrix is a partial match at the original tolerance. The origin of the difference was not decomposed and is therefore not attributed. Integer-rounded counts handed to DESeq2 match on all 500 entries, yielding 0.00e+00 delta in LFC and Wald p-values.
